items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Al Morgan was the first guy to come in after Smitty.

ctx.x: How did we get Bass Morgan?

I don't know. He was a bass player... See, Morgan was playing the string bass, and we was getting...we was a little advancin', I guess you would call it -- steppin' up. I guess we was too kind of patterned after Duke, because Duke was the hot band.
